entities.name: AWS
entities.rationale: AWS public cloud environment serving as a source for telemetry and security event logs.

entities.name: ON-PREM
entities.rationale: On-premises environment providing syslog and data stream events to the pipeline.

entities.name: APACHE METRON
entities.rationale: Apache Metron stream processing engine for real-time security data ingest, enrichment, and triaging.

entities.name: EMR
entities.rationale: Amazon EMR cluster processing and transforming persistent telemetry data.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 bucket used as the primary storage layer for the Security Data Lake.

entities.name: ATHENA
entities.rationale: Amazon Athena analytics service used to query transformed data in S3.

entities.name: SOAR
entities.rationale: Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response platform for orchestrating threat mitigation.

entities.name: ALERTS
entities.rationale: Security analysts/operators receiving and reviewing security alerts.

entities.name: WAF
entities.rationale: AWS WAF web application firewall used for automated or analyst-triggered blocking.

visual_connections.description: Ingests telemetry events from AWS cloud sources into Apache Metron.
Ingests syslog and stream events from on-premise infrastructure into Apache Metron.
Sends prioritized alerts and security events to the SOAR platform.
Dispatches actionable alerts to SOC analysts.
Triggers mitigation rules and block actions on AWS WAF.
Passes persistent telemetry data to Amazon EMR for transformation.
Stores transformed telemetry data into Amazon S3.
Queries stored log data in Amazon S3 via Amazon Athena.
